args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon, going by this channel: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (company time, UTC-5). You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

From 10:42 the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, which is the only guard activity you mentioned. That carried on until the kiosks recovered. Mateo said Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM, and the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07 AM (posted 11:08). So the clipboard stretch was about 25 minutes. The channel doesn't say exactly when the guard stopped using it.
